messages:
anya: We got a DSAR that references a user record stored in an old embeddings export (embeds-legacy bucket). Requester asks for deletion + proof.
jamal: The export was encrypted with key `embeds-old-key-v2`. That key was scheduled for decommission last year; need to confirm whether snapshots are still decryptable.
ops-lee: I can check KMS. FYI we removed IAM bindings for wide groups when we spun down the old pipeline. Seems only a few service accounts still have access.
security-bot: auto-note: retention-exception candidate created (ticket #SE-11001). Any RBAC tweaks require approval.
anya: Legal, what proof format do we need for DSAR closure?
legal-sam: NDJSON manifest of deleted object paths, KMS decrypt audit lines, and a short signed attestation about snapshot/backups. 30-day window to remediate snapshots if required.
jamal: Options for snapshots: targeted rewrite/redact, or attest inaccessibility via key decommission. Legal prefers redact when possible.
ops-lee: Plan: (1) run a dry-run list to enumerate matches, (2) request a short-lived decrypt grant to run delete job if necessary, (3) emit NDJSON proof lines and attach KMS logs, (4) file retention-exception if snapshots need redaction.
anya: Keep any grant minimal and timeboxed. Document in ticket SE-11001.
ops-lee: Dry-run complete. Few matches found. I'll request a 2-hour grant and run delete after legal ack.
legal-sam: Ack. Please attach artifacts once done; will sign confirmation then.
security-bot: Reminder: revoke ephemeral grants at expiry and record exception in audit log.
anya: Thanks team — keeping thread as approval record.
